GET /search/compare now drive-filters and gates its CLIP channel per drive. Spec §7 does not describe this, and no test covers it.; With a drive, the CLIP channel can run up to four KNNs (k up to 4096) plus a large IN query on search.db per search. Spec §10 does not describe this cost.

execute_search_compare with no drive (drive=None) takes the unfiltered single-KNN path. The spec does not state this for compare.; _drive_thumbnail_neighbours stops after the first KNN that returns fewer rows than asked (partition exhausted), and returns [] as soon as one KNN returns nothing.
